recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the original FHIR-24097 canonical URL correction across current build-scope source without reopening separate later MedicationDispense.status code-content decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-24097 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy QA issue for MedicationDispense.status, applied for R5, requesting that the required binding for this code-typed element use the internally defined medicationdispense-status codes instead of a terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem URI.
initial_application: The February 2020 application commit 8c940464f5f46e1b990e93df032065d1717847de changed source/medicationdispense/codesystem-medicationdispense-status.xml and source/medicationdispense/valueset-medicationdispense-status.xml from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/medicationdispense-status to http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationdispense-status. Current MedicationDispense.status is type code and binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationdispense-status, but adjacent source still had a mis-cased CodeSystem.valueSet backlink and a primary example using a Coding with the old THO system URI.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicationdispense=MedicationDispense in the active resources section, so the resource definition, terminology files, and examples under source/medicationdispense are current build inputs. FHIR-36259 and the linked terminology Zulip discussion later reaffirmed that R5 FHIR-defined MedicationDispense code systems should use hl7.org/fhir rather than terminology.hl7.org. FHIR-40692 later changed MedicationDispense.status code content but did not alter the URL ownership conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationdispense/codesystem-medicationdispense-status.xml so CodeSystem.valueSet points to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationdispense-status, and changed source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense-example.xml so the primitive status element is represented as <status value="completed"/> instead of a Coding with the old THO system.
source_changes: source/medicationdispense/codesystem-medicationdispense-status.xml: corrected the CodeSystem.valueSet backlink from http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationDispense-status to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationdispense-status.

source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense-example.xml: changed MedicationDispense.status from a Coding using http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/medicationdispense-status to the primitive code form <status value="completed"/>.

related_jiras.note: Later Pharmacy issue and Zulip discussion about MedicationDispense-related CodeSystem URLs; it supports the hl7.org/fhir direction for R5 but concerns separate status-reason/category artifacts.
Later Applied issue changed MedicationDispense.status code content in the same CodeSystem but did not change the canonical URL or binding ownership decision.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy QA issue for MedicationDispense.status requiring internally defined medicationdispense-status codes.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final WG intent to use the FHIR-owned medicationdispense-status canonical for the code-typed status binding.

evidence_items.summary: The active resources section maps medicationdispense=MedicationDispense.
evidence_items.learned: MedicationDispense resource source and examples are in current build scope.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationDispense.status is type code with required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationdispense-status, whose compose includes http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationdispense-status.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative binding surface already reflects FHIR-24097, so remaining fixes should align adjacent source rather than change binding semantics.

evidence_items.summary: Before reconciliation, the status CodeSystem backlink used medicationDispense-status and the primary example encoded status as a Coding with the old THO system URI.
evidence_items.learned: These build-scope source surfaces still contradicted the FHIR-24097 canonical and primitive code representation.

evidence_items.summary: The original multi-issue application changed the MedicationDispense status CodeSystem URL and ValueSet include from terminology.hl7.org to hl7.org/fhir.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-24097 had been partially applied, but history explains why only adjacent cleanup was needed now.

evidence_items.summary: A 2022 terminology discussion linked from FHIR-36259 said the MedicationDispense code system should not use a THO URL and should be fixed in R5.
evidence_items.learned: Later community evidence supports, rather than reverses, the FHIR-24097 URI direction.
